Elena / Ops —

Quick update: after talking with Marcus and Alex we recommend moving the live demo to Thu Mar 20 at 16:00 CET / 11:00 ET. Two reasons:

- We want to make sure APAC partners (Tom Birch is looping in) can join — that time shifts the burdens slightly later for EU but gives a better evening slot for APAC.
- The extra week gives our integration lead time to enable the FinIntel sandbox and pre-populate sample queries so the demo is more interactive.

If Mar 20 doesn't work, we can keep Mar 13 and record the session for APAC — but we thought a live cross-region session would be higher impact. Please reply with OK / decline and any time constraints.

If you prefer, we can also propose two short windows (11:00 ET or 15:00 ET) and let you pick.

Thanks,
Naomi
